<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">

  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients for each step -->

      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Small arrow marker for entry points -->
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,8 L8,4 z" fill="#313131"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#b0b0b0"/>
  
  <!-- Main circular path -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="300" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#7d7d7d" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="none"/>
  
  <!-- Arrows at center of arcs (36° between boxes), tangential to circle, clockwise -->

  <path d="M 305,182 L 325,172" fill="none" stroke="#313131" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  
  <!-- Arrow between Step 1 and Step 2 (108° from top) -->
  <path d="M 505,195 L 520,210" fill="none" stroke="#313131" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 750" width="1000" height="750">
  <!-- 4-Level Pyramid Template - Consistent Angles with Gaps -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients for each level -->
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    <!-- Shadow filter -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="1000" height="750" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- 
    Pyramid geometry for 4 levels with consistent slopes:
    - Apex: (500, 188)
    - Base: from (250, 569) to (750, 569) - 500px wide
    - Total height: 381px

    - 6px gaps between levels
    
    Level heights (excluding gaps):

    - Level 2: 90px (y=284 to y=374)

        font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#ffffff">

• Volume: Data is highest, wisdom is rare

  • Effort: Each level requires more processing
  • Goal: Drive data-informed decisions

content.subtitle: SVG Template: hub_spoke_4
content.diagram_html:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <!-- Enhanced Hub & Spoke Template with 4 Nodes -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients for richer visual appearance -->
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    <!-- Enhanced shadow filter -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="3" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.2"/>
      <feComposite in2="offsetblur" operator="in"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Glow effect for hub -->
    <filter id="hub_glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Smaller arrow markers (40% of original size) -->
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="4" markerHeight="4" refX="3.2" refY="1.2" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
